lines.trans: Vitya, what are you doing here right now?
Vitya, I am actually talking to you!
It is already two o'clock in the afternoon outside!
Were you drinking here all night again?
No, Dima, I did not drink at all.
I was making the new menu all night!
I see very well what kind of menu you made.
I will cook a new dish for you right now!
What will you cook when you are so tired?
Dima, for some reason I cannot feel my arm!
Wait, Dima, look, I am fine.
Come on, I just slept badly.
Here look, water got on me too.
